# Film Budgets and Worldwide Revenue

This page explores the relationship between production budgets and worldwide box-office revenues. As shown in @fig-budget-revenue, the scatter plot helps us examine whether films with larger budgets tend to generate higher revenues.

::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])

plt.xlabel("Production Budget (Million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("Film Budget vs. Worldwide Revenue")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```
